```{r setup}
# Set working directory to project root if rendering from 09_reporting/
if (basename(getwd()) == "09_reporting") setwd("..")

library(gt)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Run the full pipeline (builds all objects in this session)
source("run_pipeline_phase01.R")

# Load report helpers
source("09_reporting/_report_helpers.R")
```

```{r report-date}
#| output: asis

# Determine which seasons stats are drawn from
mlb_stats_season <- if (exists("player_season_mlb_offense") && nrow(player_season_mlb_offense) > 0)
  unique(player_season_mlb_offense$season)[1] else NA

fg_stats_season  <- if (exists("player_season_fg_offense") && nrow(player_season_fg_offense) > 0)
  unique(player_season_fg_offense$season)[1] else NA

stats_note <- if (!is.na(mlb_stats_season) && !is.na(fg_stats_season) &&
                  mlb_stats_season != fg_stats_season) {
  paste0(" *(MLB stats: ", mlb_stats_season,
         " · FanGraphs stats: ", fg_stats_season, ")*")
} else if (!is.na(mlb_stats_season)) {
  paste0(" *(", mlb_stats_season, " season stats)*")
} else ""

cat(paste0(
  "> **", format(target_date, "%A, %B %d, %Y"), "** — ",
  nrow(game_context), " games", stats_note
))
```

---

```{r games}
#| output: asis

for (gpk in game_context$game_pk) {

  game    <- game_context %>% dplyr::filter(game_pk == gpk)
  matchup <- sprintf("%s @ %s", game$away_team_name, game$home_team_name)

  # ── Game heading ──────────────────────────────────────────
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", matchup))

  # ── Game header table ─────────────────────────────────────
  cat(gt::as_raw_html(make_game_header_gt(gpk)))
  cat("\n\n")

  # ── Starters ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("### Starting Pitchers\n\n")
  cat(gt::as_raw_html(make_starter_gt(gpk)))
  cat("\n\n")

  # ── Lineups (side by side) ────────────────────────────────
  cat("### Lineups\n\n")
  cat('<div style="display:flex; gap:1.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:flex-start;">\n')
  cat('<div style="flex:1; min-width:320px;">\n')
  cat(gt::as_raw_html(make_lineup_gt(gpk, "away")))
  cat('\n</div>\n')
  cat('<div style="flex:1; min-width:320px;">\n')
  cat(gt::as_raw_html(make_lineup_gt(gpk, "home")))
  cat('\n</div>\n')
  cat('</div>\n\n')

  # ── Bullpen (side by side) ────────────────────────────────
  cat("### Bullpen\n\n")

  # Availability legend
  cat('<p style="font-size:12px; margin-bottom:6px;">',
      '<span style="background:#27ae60;color:white;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;">Fresh</span> &nbsp;',
      '<span style="background:#a9dfbf;color:#1a5276;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;">Available</span> &nbsp;',
      '<span style="background:#f39c12;color:white;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;">Limited</span> &nbsp;',
      '<span style="background:#e74c3c;color:white;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;">Unavailable</span> &nbsp;',
      '<span style="background:#d5d8dc;color:#7f8c8d;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;">Injured</span>',
      '</p>\n\n')

  cat('<div style="display:flex; gap:1.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:flex-start;">\n')
  cat('<div style="flex:1; min-width:340px;">\n')
  cat(gt::as_raw_html(make_bullpen_gt(gpk, "away")))
  cat('\n</div>\n')
  cat('<div style="flex:1; min-width:340px;">\n')
  cat(gt::as_raw_html(make_bullpen_gt(gpk, "home")))
  cat('\n</div>\n')
  cat('</div>\n\n')

  cat('<hr style="border:none; border-top:2px solid #dee2e6; margin:2rem 0;">\n\n')
}
```
